DIAGNOSIS READY: Laryngomalacia with tracheomalacia.

The clinical picture of stridor and wheezing worsening with crying, feeding, and neck flexion, combined with post-prandial vomiting, is highly characteristic of laryngomalacia often associated with tracheomalacia.
